Cirque Le Soir — Luxury Nightclub & Private Hire Venue in Soho, London

Cirque Le Soir is London's most exclusive nightclub and private event venue, set at 15-21 Ganton Street in Soho. The venue is renowned for VIP table bookings, bottle service, champagne shows, immersive nightlife, bespoke circus-themed performances and full private hire for corporate events, Christmas parties, summer parties, Halloween parties, brand activations and milestone celebrations in the heart of London's West End.
